Why swimming is the most
underrated sport for men
It trains your whole body. Back, shoulders, legs, core and lungs, all at once, without the impact that hurts knees and joints.
It's a lifelong skill. You can swim at 20 and still swim at 80. Few sports stay with you for that long. A sport for life.
It calms your mind. The rhythm of your strokes and breathing feels almost like meditation. Many men find it their quietest hour.
It improves your breathing. Learning to control your breath in the water helps with stress, sport and sleep. Breath is power.
Before: training was just about my body. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and I train my mind as well.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: training was just about my body. After: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. I train my mind as well.

slides.texte_overlay: It keeps you safe. Being a strong swimmer means you can enjoy the sea, lakes and boats with confidence. Swim with confidence.
Take a few lessons as an adult. Good technique makes swimming easier and much more enjoyable. Book one lesson this month and see how it feels.
